title: corylus avellana subsp. memorabilis
intro: Corylus avellana subsp. memorabilis, commonly known as English Hazel, is a subspecies of the Hazel tree native to Europe. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving circulation, and providing antioxidant protection. The health benefits of Corylus avellana subsp. memorabilis are attributed to its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects.
